decision_question: After the valid L40S c12 raw-FP8 lower bound closed both economic envelopes, what single immediately runnable paid experiment has the best chance to create material whole-request margin?

controlling_l40s_closure.disposition: close L40S online-FP8 c12; do not transfer its throughput or admission to another GPU

ranked_candidates.candidate: H100 SXM actual paged BF16-KV versus FP8-E4M3-KV component
ranked_candidates.expected_whole_request_cost_margin: The exact-shape analytical bound saves 58.44680214925373 ms/request after full-L2 credit, 10.665956924217314% of the 547.9752315195353 ms H100 planning service time and 2.133x the 27.398761575976767 ms 5% hurdle. This is a plausibility bound, not achieved performance.
ranked_candidates.information_value: Directly distinguishes HBM-byte savings from launch/compute limitation with actual paged producer/consumer calls and counters.
ranked_candidates.runtime_support: Pinned source traces unified_kv_cache_update and actual FlashAttention/Triton paged FP8 consumers on SM90; the exact immutable image is already available by digest.
ranked_candidates.checkpoint_setup: checkpoint-free; image plus component program only
ranked_candidates.time_to_valid_result: one retrieved two-geometry sentinel followed by a bounded c8/c16/c32 sweep

ranked_candidates.candidate: H200 BF16 c32 actual attention residual
ranked_candidates.reason: The measured prefill-linears plus decode-linears/head floor 0.4433561450894726 s/request plus the optimistic full-L2-credit BF16-KV bandwidth floor 0.05799790933333333 s/request is 0.5013540544228059, already above the 0.47751364375858635 lenient service ceiling before QK/AV arithmetic, cache writes, norms, scheduler, or service overhead. Another paid attention repair is unlikely to create margin.

The exact trace has only 12.69976% block-cacheable prompt reuse and needs >=39.3755% measured exposed prefill time for a 5% endpoint effect. It requires checkpoint staging and an exact endpoint/cache telemetry consumer, while no valid H100 exact-trace lifecycle binding exists.

ranked_candidates.candidate: H100 native Gemma-4 MTP or async scheduling
ranked_candidates.reason: The analytical acceptance surface can exceed 5%, but the next evidence requires the exact target and assistant checkpoints, raw output/acceptance instrumentation, and a valid H100 endpoint control. The historical H100 attempts produced no scientific output, so this would begin another readiness/setup chain.

selected_paid_arm.name: h100_actual_paged_fp8_kv_component_falsifier

authoritative_local_inputs.role: exact source trace, geometry, discriminator, producer/consumer and acceptance contract
official exact-revision config metadata; no checkpoint transfer is authorized

h100_cleanup_evidence.result: cleanup_pass true; zero instances and disks

proven_lifecycle.requirements: One lowercase user-systemd durable owner and one sequential VerifiedRetainedOwner/watchdog own create, spend, atomic stage retrieval, and authenticated cleanup. One allocation; no repair or restart. Do not create another lifecycle or readiness project.

scientific_contract.producer_consumer: Invoke the pinned image's unified_kv_cache_update with deterministic varied-sign nonzero K/V, then the actual selected paged backend with block_table, slot_mapping and seqused_k. Dense-varlen or direct-kernel stand-ins fail.

continuation_sweep.timing: 20 warmups and 100 randomized paired repetitions per row; alternate arm order; CUDA events plus synchronized wall; setup/allocation excluded
counters: dram__bytes_read.sum over the exact NVTX attention range

scientific_contract.oracle: Consume every timed output; FP8 versus the same nonzero BF16 paged output must have cosine similarity >=0.99 and normalized RMSE <=0.05 on every row.

acceptance.component: FP8 p50 interval-union attention time >=10% lower at every engine-valid selected point
acceptance.mechanism: FP8 DRAM read bytes <=60% of BF16 at every row, with unchanged launch count and context-scaled byte reduction
acceptance.whole_request: Architecture-weighted measured saving across 50 local and 10 global layers over 358 steps is >=0.027398761575976767 s/request

scientific_contract.evidence_boundary: A pass is a checkpoint-free semantics-changing cost-mechanism result only; it is not endpoint throughput, deployable quality, reliability, or economic acceptance.

selected_paid_arm.stop_rule: Stop and clean immediately on identity/image/source-symbol/backend mismatch, producer/consumer construction failure, oracle failure, missing atomic sentinel retrieval, invalid timing/counter range, any sentinel mechanism threshold failure, deadline reserve below seven provider minutes, or budget violation. After one valid sweep, evaluate once and clean regardless of outcome.

optional_adjacent_retained_session.name: h100_exact_shape_direct_fp8_linears
optional_adjacent_retained_session.trigger: Only when both atomically retrieved sentinel rows pass all identity/oracle/component/mechanism gates, measured bootstrap plus image setup exceeds scored primary GPU time, the H100 linears program is ready offline within ten minutes, and at least seven provider minutes remain.
optional_adjacent_retained_session.arm: On the same H100/image/session, fresh-match BF16 matmul versus actual cutlass_scaled_mm FP8 at the six exact Gemma fused-linear shapes for M=8/16/32 and M=3679, using the corrected dual oracle and no L40S timing/admission transfer.
optional_adjacent_retained_session.acceptance: Every row passes the dual oracle and stable timing; report the architecture-weighted H100 linear saving separately from the KV result.
optional_adjacent_retained_session.false_trigger: tear down immediately; do not retain for checkpoint staging, compilation, endpoint, MTP, prefix cache, W4, or another project
